resizeWarning.body: Existing artwork may end up out of position when the size or style changes. Check the layout after updating.

setup.patternRange: {label} must be {min}–{max} mm for this pattern

printRules.title: Print requirements
printRules.safeZoneBody: Keep text and logos at least 3 mm from any cut or fold line (the green dashed line).
printRules.bleedBody: Backgrounds and patterns should run 3 mm past the cut line; the exported PDF includes it.
printRules.resolutionBody: Images should be at least 300 dpi at final size.
printRules.typeSizeBody: Nothing smaller than 6 pt (about 2.1 mm), and no line thinner than 0.25 pt.
printRules.colourBody: Screen colour differs from print (RGB → CMYK), especially for vivid and neon colours.
printRules.corrugatedBody: A brown liner darkens everything printed on it — choose darker, higher-contrast colours.

saveState.offline: Offline — kept on this device, saves when back online

history.title: Version history
history.body: Every save is kept as a version; restoring an old one does not erase the history

conflict.title: Saved somewhere else
conflict.body: This design was saved from another tab or device after you opened it. Choose which version to keep — the other stays in the history.
conflict.saveCopy: Save mine as a new design

draft.title: Unsaved changes are waiting on this device

readOnly.title: View only
readOnly.body: A customer's design cannot be changed; make a copy to edit

order.failed: Could not send the file — try again

confirm.title: Send this design as the artwork for order {order}?
confirm.body: A print PDF is made (die lines on their own layers, artwork at 300 dpi with bleed) and checked at once. The team sends a proof before production.

result.blockedTitle: The file did not pass the check
result.blockedBody: Fix the items below and send again
result.warnBody: The file passed, with the notes below. The team will send a proof.
result.okBody: The file passed. The team will send a proof before production.
